description:
Advances: ancora.derive, ancora.findings, ancora.gate, ancora.tasks

Wave 2 of ancora-gg8, after the requirement-scoped-overrides ticket (shares finding.ex and config matching). B2 + E2 in the investigation record; findings-B, findings-DE, and the architecture decision are comments on the epic. This is the big one: the 46-error drift fan-out (seven changed shared functions, 25 untouched subjects, a pipeline blocked 5h20m on a human Spec-Ack ruling) plus the structurally unanswerable "what did this ack suppress".

Deliverable:
A. Primary/transitive drift split via the authored `surface:` field:
- A drift finding is PRIMARY (existing code derived/drift, existing default) when the drifted binding's defining file (already computed: defining_file/2, lib/ancora/derive/compare.ex:155-166) appears in the subject's spec-meta `surface:` list. Otherwise emit the NEW registry code derived/drift_transitive, default info, diff-scoped.
- Subjects without a `surface:` list treat all drift as primary — corpora that never authored the field get the status quo, no behavior change.
- Two codes keep the closed registry; config severities, per-subject/per-requirement overrides, and Spec-Ack trailers compose for free because every mechanism keys on code.
B. Ack visibility (mark, don't discard):
- At lib/ancora/gate.ex:139-152 the gate currently Enum.rejects acknowledged subjects' derived/drift, growth, and shrink findings before the report exists. Instead mark them: severity info, new severity_source value :ack (extend the type at lib/ancora/finding.ex:21). They flow into all_findings and --json. Zero added compute — Compare already ran.
- Per-source rollup in the DEFAULT branch summary line: the hidden-info count becomes per-source, e.g. `(error=E warning=W info=N hidden: default=D trailer=T ack=A)`. Data already on every finding as severity_source. Survives any consumer wrapper or container.
- New spec.check flag --explain-acks: lists only findings with severity_source in [:trailer, :ack], independent of --verbose/ANCORA_SHOW_INFO.

Spec delta (land in this same diff):
- ancora.findings.registry_closed: count 30 -> 31, add derived/drift_transitive to the enumerated list.
- ancora.findings.registry_defaults: add info default for derived/drift_transitive.
- ancora.findings.severity_precedence: severity_source gains :ack ("A finding suppressed by subject acknowledgment shall be retained at info with severity_source :ack, not destroyed").
- ancora.findings.info_visibility: the branch summary "shall report the hidden count per severity source (default, trailer, ack)".
- ancora.gate.acknowledgment_clears: "suppress" becomes "resolve to info with severity_source :ack"; add that acknowledged findings appear in all_findings and JSON.
- ancora.gate.diff_scoped_versus_repo_state: add derived/drift_transitive to the diff-scoped list.
- ancora.derive: new requirement ancora.derive.drift_primary_transitive (must) stating the surface-membership split and the no-surface status quo, with scenarios: (1) shared binding drifts, subject reaches it transitively, surface list lacks the defining file -> derived/drift_transitive at info; (2) same drift, defining file in surface -> derived/drift; (3) subject without surface: -> derived/drift for all.
- ancora.tasks.finding_line_format: branch summary grammar updated to the per-source hidden rollup.
- ancora.tasks.check_flags: add --explain-acks to the exact flag list, with a scenario (ack + trailer findings listed, default-info findings not).
- ancora.tasks (added by orchestrator 2026-09-04T00:20Z, carried over from ancora-gg8.1): one sentence on the statement describing status/check config handling: spec.status and spec.check shall reject an override naming an unknown requirement id with config/invalid_value and ignore the entry (the behavior gg8.1 landed in Status.build and Gate.check; its drift on ancora.tasks was trailer-covered, and this is the honest statement).

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged tests for every new/edited requirement above; the fan-out replay fixture — one shared function in N subjects' transitive footprints, surface lists naming it in only K -> exactly K derived/drift and N-K derived/drift_transitive; goldens updated for the new summary grammar; JSON golden showing :ack findings in all_findings.
- Behaviors to demonstrate: all scenarios above; drift_cleared_by_spec_edit now yields an info :ack finding in all_findings instead of nothing; --explain-acks output.
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale plus targeted files, and mix spec.validate; no full suite mid-iteration.
  - Final tier: before IMPLEMENTED, full mix test plus mix spec.check --base <stage-base>, run-until-green.
  - Verifier tier: mix spec.check --base <stage-base> and targeted/--stale selections only; no full suite.
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface, with the proving test that exercises that production path
  - Fixture/sandbox hygiene: async-safe tmp-repo fixtures, no cross-test leakage
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable/config surface
  - Every conditional clause covered by a test
- Call-site Integration: the split lives on Compare's existing gate call path; --explain-acks's production caller is Mix.Tasks.Spec.Check via TaskArgs; proving tests are the subprocess goldens.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/policy_files.ex
- lib/ancora/change_analysis.ex (no tag/append disclosure codes here — that is the next ticket)
- lib/ancora/append_only.ex
- lib/ancora/trailer.ex (grammar unchanged; sfu's non-tip warning is its own standalone ticket)

Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/ancora/derive/compare.ex
- lib/ancora/gate.ex
- lib/ancora/finding.ex
- lib/ancora/severity.ex
- lib/ancora/output.ex and lib/ancora/output/**
- lib/ancora/task_args.ex and lib/mix/tasks/spec.check.ex (flag wiring)
- test/**
- lib/ancora/review.ex (only: keep drift findings with severity_source :ack rendered as acknowledged; ruling 2026-09-04T00:33Z)
- docs/migration.md and priv/spec_init/agents/SKILL.md.eex (registry enumeration: the new code and count; ruling 2026-09-04T00:33Z)
- .spec/README.md (only the registry count/enumeration line; ruling 2026-09-04T00:58Z)
- .spec/specs/ancora.review.spec.md (only if derived/drift fires on ancora.review from the review.ex change: one substantive sentence that acknowledged drift renders as acknowledged, plus the decisions: link; ruling 2026-09-04T00:33Z)
- .spec/specs/ancora.findings.spec.md, .spec/specs/ancora.gate.spec.md, .spec/specs/ancora.derive.spec.md, .spec/specs/ancora.tasks.spec.md (the statement edits and scenarios above, plus acknowledgment edits for this stage's own changes only)
- .spec/decisions/ancora.decision.field_friction_response.md (exactly one change: add `- ancora.parsing` to affects:, because ancora-gg8.4 amended ancora.parsing under this ADR and the list omits it; orchestrator note 2026-09-03T23:15Z. Also add `ancora.decision.field_friction_response` to the decisions: frontmatter of each spec you edit.)

Out of Scope (intent):
- No per-binding drift aggregation and no binding-scoped ack grammar (declined on the epic)
- No trailer grammar changes of any kind
- config `off` continues to destroy findings (defensible designed silence; counting it was declined)
- Growth/shrink stay whole — only their ack disposition changes (mark, don't discard)

Merge gate:
- [ ] Code compiles cleanly
- [ ] Tests listed above pass
- [ ] Spec verification passes
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket

title: Split derived/drift primary vs transitive and make acknowledgments visible
